title: Adoption of AM in Manufacturing
summary: Companies are adopting additive manufacturing for prototyping, low-volume production, and custom parts. The aerospace, medical, and automotive industries have been particularly quick to adopt this technology.
body:
**On-Demand | 34 minutes**

Additive manufacturing is becoming increasingly popular in the manufacturing imdustry. This is due to its ability to produce complex parts quickly and with high precision.

Companies are adopting additive manufacturing for prototyping, low-volume production and custom parts. The aerospace, medical and automotive industries have been particularly quick to adopt this technology.

In this webinar presented by Stratasys Manager, Application Engineer, Sathish Kumar, you would be able to explore and learn about the Adoption of AM in Mnaufacturing.

We will also cover on the:

-   AM Technologies
-   Advanced Materials for Tooling applications
-   Case Studies
-   Indusrty 4.0 & Latest trends in AM
